response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced polyglot engineer with 15+ years in software, but their career centers on web and full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang), not C++. Their only professional C++ experience was a brief 7-month role at National Instruments ending in 2015. The role's core requirements — modern C++/STL, message brokers at scale, MQTT/IoT, and IEC 62443 secure development for industrial automation — are largely absent from this profile, making the fit poor despite strong general engineering credentials.
strengths: Extensive overall software experience with strong systems exposure (low-latency, async I/O, high-throughput services in DLang)
Solid engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, pairing, plus mentoring and workshop/teaching experience
Some relevant adjacent skills: event-driven architecture, Node.js, REST APIs, embedded and hardware exposure
concerns: Minimal and outdated professional C++ experience (7 months, ended 2015)
No evidence of industrial cybersecurity, IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, MQTT)
No industrial automation domain background; career trajectory has moved toward web/full-stack and AI tooling

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering and systems experience
